title: First run steps 3 and 4: start the first task from a small issue and watch it merge
description: A real browser on the built dashboard opens a fresh install whose repository and Builder are connected and whose loop reported open issues. Step 3 lists the small-labelled issue, then the shortest bodies, three in all, and a free-text box. Starting the seeded issue creates one released task with an E2E-proof criterion drafted from it. Step 4 shows that task's pipeline and the stub Builder's live session; when the task merges the shipped toast names the time from start to merge and the install opens on Home.
